set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1b (FilmFestival task).

Scene within film needs: the +106 renumbering of Run-2 segments, run-relative min.sec times parsed as mm.ss, the annotation-clock vs BIDS-clock offset (title cards; the cartoon at BIDS onset 3 s), and media equivalence (bus_stop is 8 s short).

Scope:
Make the clock and ordinal mapping explicit and tested; add the task descriptor for the eight films with media.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The Run-2 +106 renumbering is a declared ordinal map in the descriptor or intake layer, not a constant in scorer code.
2. Run-relative min.sec times are parsed as mm.ss with 2-dp rounding; tests cover dirty floats such as 6.1000000000000005.
3. The annotation-clock offset is established against the local media and recorded with frame or audio timestamps.
4. Per-film media equivalence (clip vs scan duration) is recorded, with bus_stop's shortfall explicit.
5. A scene-within-film task descriptor exists for the eight films with media.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: Phase 1b: FilmFestival clock work for the scene-within-film task
